From: Amanda Li <amanda@greenfield.health>

Cc: security@greenfield.health
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Greenfield Health — Request: employee training & background evidence

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of our SIG/SOC 2 intake for a potential integration, we need a short package demonstrating Redwood's personnel controls related to onboarding/offboarding and employee training. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOD next Wednesday (5 business days):

- Current training completion roster for all engineering + infra staff (CSV acceptable)
- Redacted background-check evidence (names redacted; show verification stamps/dates)
- Onboarding and offboarding runbook / checklist (process-level doc)
- Recent refresher training logs (last 12 months)
- Point of contact for SOC 2 attestations and any outstanding gaps

We are OK with a shared Drive folder or a secure upload. If anything is sensitive, please indicate redaction steps. Our assessment team (security@greenfield.health) may follow up with a short questionnaire.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of timeline.

Thanks,
Amanda Li
Security Manager
Greenfield Health

Plan: Olga will assemble the artifacts and Monica will confirm the redaction standard for BG checks. We can deliver a Drive folder with redacted PDFs + a CSV training roster, and include the onboarding/offboarding runbook.

Clarification: for redaction, do you need full redaction of employee names, or just partial (last name redacted, employee ID visible)? We typically provide fully redacted names for third-party review but can provide pseudonymized IDs on request.

I'll target an initial bundle by Monday COB and the refresher logs by Wednesday per your timeline. If Greenfield prefers a short walkthrough call with our compliance lead, we can schedule one — Olga, can you propose two windows?
